58/S0.subgoal: Describe the 3D graphics pipeline and identify the fifth stage as scan conversion or rendering.

58/S1.subgoal: Explain the scan-conversion problem of mapping continuous viewport coordinates to a discrete pixel grid.

58/S2.subgoal: Describe how points and lines are mapped to pixels, including Bresenham's integer line-drawing algorithm and why it improves rendering speed.

58/S3.subgoal: Explain why aliasing, anti-aliasing, and VR-specific realistic and dynamic content increase rendering computational complexity.

58/S4.subgoal: Describe how graphics libraries and APIs let programmers implement pipeline stages without handling low-level system details.

58/S5.subgoal: Describe the layered VR software architecture connecting applications, SDKs, engines, native rendering libraries, the operating system, and hardware.

58/S6.subgoal: Explain how GPUs exploit parallelism to execute transformation, lighting, projection, rasterization, texturing, and hidden-surface removal efficiently.

58/S7.subgoal: Summarize the main points of the lecture.
